name: Rain
text: This is the town called [Map 1010000], located at the northeast part of the Maple Island. You know that Maple Island is for beginners, right? I'm glad there are only weak monsters around this place.

name: Rain
text: If you want to get stronger, then go to [Map 60000] where there's an harbor, ride on the gigantic ship and head to the place called Victoria Island. It's incomparable in size compared to this tiny island.

name: Rain
text: At the Victoria Island you can choose your job. Is it called [Map 102000000]...? I heard there's a bare, desolate town where warriors live. A highland...what kind of a place would that be?
